title: Multiplicative Jacobian point comparison for Picard base change
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a proper smooth connected curve [def-sc-curves]. Write $X'=X\times_k k'$ and $f':X'\to\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $G\subseteq\operatorname{Pic}(X)$ and $G'\subseteq\operatorname{Pic}(X')$ be subgroups whose underlying sets are the degree-zero Picard classes [def-sc-pic0]. Let $j:G\to G'$ be a homomorphism whose underlying Picard classes are the canonical pullbacks. There exist an abelian variety J over k equipped with a commutative group structure and multiplicative equivalences e:G ≃ J(k) and e':G' ≃ J(k'), such that e'(j(x)) is the extension of e(x) for every x in G. Here J(k') denotes morphisms Spec k' to J over k.

source.place: Proper degree-one comparison and Jacobian base-change compatibility square

proof.text: Connectedness over the algebraically closed field gives geometric connectedness. The regularity argument for smooth geometrically connected schemes gives geometric irreducibility, and smoothness gives geometric reducedness, hence geometric integrality. The source-library dimension criterion smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff_topologicalKrullDim_eq gives smooth relative dimension one from IsConnectedCurve.krullDim_eq_one.

Apply exists_jacobian to obtain one commutative representing group scheme J, proper, geometrically integral, and smooth of the indicated relative dimension. These properties give IsAbelianVariety J. Transport G and Gprime to picardZero using coe_ker_picDegreeHom and the supplied underlying-set equalities. Smooth relative dimension one and properness on the pullback follow by the existing base-change instances.

Use the existing source declarations exists_picardZero_equiv_picardFunctorDegree_zero and exists_picardZero_equiv_picardFunctorDegree to compare G and Gprime with values of the original Picard sheaf at Spec k and Spec kprime. In the latter theorem take the canonical pullback square: its isoPullback is the identity, by the two projection equations and pullback.hom_ext. The recorded formulas identify both comparisons with the sheafification unit. Apply exists_mulEquiv_of_isPicardZeroMul to the same representation r for both comparisons to obtain multiplicative equivalences e and eprime.

Apply the injectivity of r.homEquiv and its naturality homEquiv_comp to reduce the square to the naturality of the sheafification unit. The Picard presheaf map is Pic.map of baseChangeMap; Pic.map_comp and pullback.lift_fst identify this map on a class pulled back from X with Pic.map of pullback.fst f b. The hypothesis hj finishes the equality.

lean.statement:
theorem pic_zero_jacobian_point_comparison
    {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed k'] [Algebra k k']
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f]
    (G : Subgroup X.Pic) (hG : (G : Set X.Pic) = f.picZero)
    (G' : Subgroup (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Pic)
    (hG' : (G' : Set (pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Pic) =
      (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).picZero)
    (j : G →* G')
    (hj : ∀ L : G, (j L).val = Scheme.Pic.mapHom
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))) L.val)
    : ∃ (J : Over (Spec (.of k))) (hJ : CommGrpObj J),
      letI := hJ
      ∃ (_ : IsAbelianVariety J) (e : G ≃* (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ J))
        (e' : G' ≃* (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) ⟶ J)),
      ∀ x : G, e' (j x) =
        toUnit (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))) ≫ e x
